title: Attempted abduction and face cutting of 15-year-old Talia
place_text: San Antonio de Pintuyacu, Amazon, Peru

tellings.quote: 15-year-old girl named Talia. She was almost abducted. That's why they the police went out there.

plain: In 2023, in San Antonio de Pintuyacu, a village in the Peruvian Amazon, a 15-year-old girl named Talia was almost abducted and had her face cut, and that attack is why the police went out there. Tim Alberino, who went to the area himself, tells Michels this as he heard it from Talia and from a man named Doug. If true, it would mean someone, or something, is attacking people in that remote village.
